name: KweriMoto Engine Sounds
recording_scope: healthy, engine knock, misfire (mixed source origins)
license: other; source ownership mixed, including YouTube/AudioSet and unlicensed source
access: manifest and dataset available on Hugging Face
quality_note: 286 synthetic knocking clips; many knocking clips not verified as cars; labels unverified; group-based splits; do not use real_test for training
recommended_role: metadata index for exploratory audio similarity / independent audit

name: Procedural Engine Sounds Dataset
recording_scope: synthetic engine RPM/torque, 8 subsets and 3 modeled engines
quality_note: NOT fault sounds; 4-channel WAV includes RPM and torque reference signals, not four conventional audio channels
recommended_role: normal engine acoustic representations and embedding robustness, noncommercial research

name: Sounds of Vehicle Internal Combustion Engines
recording_scope: 350 vehicles sampled in underground garage; idle and partial acceleration
license: verify rights at source before reuse
quality_note: engine operational baseline; no fault diagnosis labels

name: OtoMobile
recording_scope: 12 failing component categories and diagnostic/context annotations
quality_note: limited size, carefully selected clips; no permission assumed

name: AudioSet
recording_scope: 632 audio-event categories including cars and engines, across YouTube
license: AudioSet labels CC BY 4.0; YouTube audio rights belong to owners
access: metadata and references; referenced clips can be unavailable
quality_note: NOT per-vehicle verified faults; avoid treating all motor-vehicle events as failures
recommended_role: pretraining references / engine and car sound taxonomy, with source rights audit
